paragraph:
# Velmoria's constitutional moment

*The (legislature) drafts a new charter, and refuses the (imposture) of perfection*

LET THIS chapter not (debase) what came before. Twelve years after the marshal's fall, Velmoria's (legislature) convened to draft a permanent constitution—a document of real (stature), meant to (erase) the last (vestige) of one-man rule and replace it with something (precise), durable, and free. It was a (juncture) the founders had long deferred, wary of acting (premature)ly, but the moment could no longer be deferred.

The drafters knew the danger of (imposture). A constitution can be a noble (treatise) or a hollow (gesture); it can (compose) a free state or merely (superimpose) fine words over old tyranny. They refused to (improvise) or to (compromise) on essentials. Each clause was (revise)d, then revised again—every (stricture) weighed, every (aperture) for abuse closed. They would not (impose) a charter from above, nor (advertise) a perfection no honest text can (disclose).

The marshal's old constitution—if the (grandiose) thing deserved the name—had been an exercise in (imposture). It promised everything and licensed everything: a single (signature), his, could (foreclose) any right, (excise) any freedom, (disfranchise) any province that displeased him. Public (expenditure) flowed at his whim; (forfeiture) of property required no trial; the courts existed only to (rinse) his crimes in the (guise) of law. To (paraphrase) one drafter, it was less a (scripture) of liberty than a (noose) dressed as an (overture).

The new charter is, by deliberate design, (terse) where the old was (verbose). It does not (incense) the reader with (lachrymose) preambles or (bellicose) declarations. Its (prose) is (coarse) and plain, almost (otiose) in its modesty—and that plainness is the point. It declares the freedoms it will not let any future (legislature) (depose): to speak, to assemble, to (chastise) those in power without fear of (forfeiture) or arrest. It binds the budget to honest oversight, so that no (expenditure) can (metamorphose) into private (lucre).

Not everyone is pleased. A (bellicose) faction of the marshal's heirs would gladly (disfranchise) every citizen the document protects, and kill it at birth. They (tease) and (chastise) the drafters, (advertise) their grievances, and try to (interpose) procedural objections at every (juncture). One demagogue, all (impulse) and (incense), sought to (impose) a clause restoring strong executive rule—an (imposture) the chamber met with (immense) and immediate (repulse). His allies attempted a (cloture) to force a (premature) vote; the Speaker, (precise) and (terse), declined.

There were quieter dramas, too. An old jurist, on the eve of the final reading, suffered a stroke and lay briefly (comatose), rallied, then (relapse)d; the chamber held its breath in (suspense) until word came that she would recover. A (glimpse) of her empty seat, draped in (turquoise) cloth, reminded the drafters what (stature) the work demanded. They did not (debase) it with haste.

The land outside the chamber has, meanwhile, grown (verdant) again. Where the marshal left (grease)-slicked ruin, there is now (horticulture): terraced gardens, an (azure) sky over clean water, fields no longer drugged with poison. The economy, once (obese) with corruption and then starved to (anemia), has found a steadier (base). Citizens (purchase) freely; merchants (advertise) honestly; the courts (supervise) without fear. No office is a (sinecure); no (investiture) of power comes without a matching (divestiture) of it, term by term.

The constitution will not (appease) everyone, and the drafters do not pretend it will. It is a (compromise) in the honest sense—a (counterpoise) of competing goods, not a (panacea). They (apprise) the public plainly: this charter is fallible, amendable, a living (treatise) rather than holy (scripture). To (revere) it as infallible would be its own kind of (imposture). Better to (revise) it openly than to let it (decompose) into dogma.

So Velmoria signs its charter without (fanfare) and without illusion. The marshal once sought to (impose) his single will as the law of the land, to (superimpose) his (signature) on every life, to make the state a (miniature) of himself. His country, twelve years past his fall, has chosen the opposite: a constitution of many hands, (terse) and (precise), that binds power rather than (debase)s the governed. It is no (utopia). It is something better—a (commonsense) agreement among free people to keep one another free, and to (chastise), without (compunction), any future strongman who would (depose) it.
translation:
韦尔莫利亚的立宪时刻

*（立法机关/legislature）起草一部新宪章，并拒绝完美的（冒充骗局/imposture)*

让这一章不去（贬损/debase）此前发生的一切。元帅倒台十二年后，韦尔莫利亚的（立法机关/legislature）召开会议，起草一部永久宪法——一份具有真正（分量地位/stature）的文件，意在（抹除/erase）一人统治的最后一点（残迹/vestige)，并以某种（精确/precise)、耐久而自由的东西取而代之。这是一个建国者们长久推迟的（关头/juncture)，他们唯恐行动得（过早仓促/premature)，但这一刻再也无法推延。

起草者们深知（冒充骗局/imposture）的危险。一部宪法可以是一篇高贵的（论著/treatise)，也可以是一个空洞的（姿态/gesture)；它可以（构成组建/compose）一个自由的国家，也可以仅仅把漂亮的字句（叠盖/superimpose）在旧的暴政之上。他们拒绝（即兴敷衍/improvise)，也拒绝在根本之处（妥协让步/compromise)。每一条款都被（修订/revise)，继而再次修订——每一道（约束限制/stricture）都被掂量，每一个可供滥用的（孔隙/aperture）都被堵上。他们不会自上而下（强加/impose）一部宪章，也不会（标榜宣扬/advertise）一种没有哪份诚实文本能够（揭示/disclose）的完美。

元帅的旧宪法——倘若那（浮夸宏大的/grandiose）东西配得上这个名字的话——曾是一桩（冒充骗局/imposture）的演练。它许诺一切，又许可一切：单单一个（签名/signature)、他的签名，便能（取消剥夺/foreclose）任何权利、（删除割去/excise）任何自由、（剥夺选举权/disfranchise）任何令他不悦的省份。公共（开支/expenditure）随他的心血来潮而流动；财产的（没收充公/forfeiture）无需审判；法庭存在的唯一目的，是在法律的（伪装幌子/guise）下把他的罪行（洗刷/rinse）干净。（转述/paraphrase）一位起草者的话来说，它与其说是一部自由的（经典/scripture)，不如说是一根装扮成（序曲开场/overture）的（绞索/noose)。

新的宪章，出于刻意的设计，在旧宪章（啰嗦冗长/verbose）之处力求（简洁/terse)。它不以（爱哭伤感的/lachrymose）序言或（好战的/bellicose）宣告去（激怒/incense）读者。它的（行文/prose）（朴素粗简/coarse）而平实，谦抑得近乎（多余赘述/otiose）——而这份平实正是要点所在。它申明它绝不容许任何未来（立法机关/legislature）（废黜罢免/depose）的那些自由：发言的自由、集会的自由、不必惧怕（没收充公/forfeiture）或被捕而（严责/chastise）当权者的自由。它把预算捆绑于诚实的监督之下，使任何（开支/expenditure）都无法（蜕变/metamorphose）成私人的（利得财帛/lucre)。

并非人人都满意。元帅继承者中一个（好战的/bellicose）派系，巴不得（剥夺选举权/disfranchise）这份文件所保护的每一个公民，并把它扼杀于襁褓之中。他们（揶揄/tease）并（责骂/chastise）起草者、（张扬宣扬/advertise）他们的怨愤、并试图在每一个（关头/juncture）（插入提出/interpose）程序上的反对。一个蛊惑民心者，满是（冲动/impulse）和（怒火/incense)，企图（强加/impose）一项恢复强势行政统治的条款——一桩（冒充骗局/imposture)，议事厅以（巨大/immense）而即刻的（驳斥击退/repulse）回敬了它。他的盟友们试图发动一次（辩论终结程序/cloture）以逼出一场（过早的/premature）表决；议长，（精确/precise）而（简洁/terse)，拒绝了。

也有些较为安静的波折。一位老法学家，在终读前夕中风，短暂地陷入（昏迷/comatose)，一度好转，继而（复发/relapse)；议事厅屏住呼吸、悬在（悬念/suspense）之中，直到传来她会康复的消息。她那张空着的、覆着（青绿色/turquoise）布的座位，（一瞥/glimpse）之间提醒着起草者们这项工作所要求的（分量地位/stature)。他们没有以仓促去（贬损/debase）它。

与此同时，议事厅之外的土地，重又（青翠葱茏/verdant)。元帅当年留下（油脂/grease）腻滑的废墟之处，如今有了（园艺/horticulture)：梯田花园、一片（蔚蓝/azure）天空覆在清洁的水面之上、不再被毒药麻醉的田地。这个经济，曾经因腐败而（臃肿肥胖/obese)、继而被饿到（贫血/anemia)，已经找到了一个更稳实的（根基/base)。公民们自由地（购买/purchase)；商人们诚实地（招揽宣传/advertise)；法庭无所畏惧地（监管/supervise)。没有哪个官职是（挂名闲职/sinecure)；权力的每一次（授予就任/investiture)，都伴随着一次相应的（卸除交还/divestiture)，一任接一任。

这部宪法不会（抚慰满足/appease）每一个人，起草者们也不假装它会。它是诚实意义上的一个（妥协/compromise)——相互竞争之善的一种（平衡制衡/counterpoise)，而非一剂（万灵药/panacea)。他们坦白地（告知/apprise）公众：这部宪章是会出错的、可修订的，是一篇活的（论著/treatise)，而非神圣的（经典/scripture)。把它（敬奉/revere）为绝无谬误，本身便是一种（冒充骗局/imposture)。与其任由它（腐化分解/decompose）成教条，不如公开地（修订/revise）它。

于是韦尔莫利亚签署它的宪章，没有（鼓乐喧庆/fanfare)，也没有幻想。元帅当年曾力图把他单一的意志（强加/impose）为这片土地的法律、把他的（签名/signature）（叠盖/superimpose）在每一条生命之上、把这个国家变成他自己的一个（缩影微缩/miniature)。他的国家，在他倒台十二年之后，选择了相反的东西：一部出自众手的宪法，（简洁/terse）而（精确/precise)，它捆绑权力、而非（贬损/debase）被治理者。它不是一座（乌托邦/utopia)。它是某种更好的东西——一群自由的人之间一项（合乎常理/commonsense）的约定，要让彼此保持自由，并毫无（愧疚踌躇/compunction）地（严惩/chastise）任何未来想要（废黜/depose）它的强人。

本批词根亮点：

• -ture 大家族：legislature/signature/stature/fracture/conjecture/stricture/juncture，全来自拉丁 -tura/-tura 名词后缀，表示行为/状态/结果

• indenture：in+dent（齿缺）+ ure，古代契约用锯齿形割开成两半，双方各执一半验证真伪，indenture=锯齿形契约

• aperture：apert（开）+ ure，来自拉丁 aperire（打开），aperture=开口=光圈，April（四月=万物开放）同根

• overture：over（向上/越过）+ ture，来自拉丁 apertura（开口），overture=序曲=开场白/主动示好

• -pose 大家族：juxtapose/depose/impose/compose/decompose/interpose/dispose/transpose，全来自拉丁 ponere（放置），位置前缀决定含义

• lachrymose：来自拉丁 lacrima（泪水），催人泪下的，lachrymatory（装泪水的瓶）同根，Lac de Larmes（泪湖）

• otiose：来自拉丁 otium（闲暇），otiose=闲散无用的，negotiate（谈判=不闲着）同根

• comatose：coma（昏迷=希腊语深睡）+ tose，昏迷状态的，coma/comma 同根

quiz.question: miniature _____
quiz.explanation: 微型的，微型的模型。He built a miniature model of the ship. 他建造了船的微型的模型。 | miniare->用红色朱砂装饰（拉丁，中世纪手稿用红色写小字），miniature->细小的装饰画=微型（cf. minimum最小，minor较小，minute细小，mini迷你） || 文化联想：北京世界公园、古建筑展览里常见按比例缩小的建筑模型，最适合帮助记忆 miniature，可以说 **a miniature model — “A museum may display a miniature model of a traditional Beijing courtyard so visitors can see its entire layout at once.”**

quiz.question: _____ legislature
quiz.explanation: 立法机关，州立法机关。The state legislature passed the bill. 州立法机关通过了法案。 | leg->法律（拉丁lex），latur->携带，ure->状态，legislature->携带法律的机构=立法机关（cf. legal法律，legislate立法，legitimate合法，allege声称） || 文化联想：在中国政治语境中，全国人民代表大会承担国家立法职能，可以帮助记忆 legislature，可以说 **the national legislature — “The National People’s Congress serves as China’s national legislature and deliberates on national laws.”**

quiz.question: premature _____
quiz.explanation: 早产的，早产的出生。The premature birth required special care. 早产的出生需要特殊护理。 | pre->之前，mature->成熟（拉丁maturus），premature->在成熟之前的=早产的（cf. mature成熟，immature不成熟，prematurely过早地） || 文化联想：现代医院里早产儿往往需要进入新生儿监护病房特别照护，最适合联想到 premature，可以说 **a premature birth — “A premature birth may require special neonatal care because the baby arrives before full term.”**

quiz.question: _______ signature
quiz.explanation: 签名，数字签名。Use a digital signature for security. 使用数字签名确保安全。 | sign->标记（拉丁signum），ature->状态/行为，signature->标记行为=签名（cf. sign标志，signal信号，significant重要，signify表示） || 文化联想：中国书画作品常有作者落款和印章，落款可以帮助理解 signature，可以说 **an artist’s signature — “On a traditional Chinese painting, the artist’s signature may appear beside a poem and a red seal.”**

quiz.question: ________ stature
quiz.explanation: 身材，高大的身材。He had a towering stature. 他有高大的身材。 | stat->站立（拉丁stare），ure->状态，stature->站立的高度=身材（cf. statue雕像，status状态，stature身材，statute法规，static静止） || 文化联想：姚明高大的身材是中国人很容易联想到 stature 的现实形象，可以说 **towering stature — “Yao Ming’s towering stature made him instantly recognizable on a basketball court.”**

quiz.question: ____ fracture
quiz.explanation: 骨折，骨骨折。The X-ray showed a bone fracture. X光显示骨骨折。 | fract->打碎（拉丁frangere），ure->结果，fracture->打碎的结果=骨折（cf. fragment碎片，fragile易碎，infraction违规，refract折射，fraction分数） || 文化联想：日常中文说“伤筋动骨”，骨头真正断裂时就是 fracture，可以说 **a bone fracture — “After a hard fall, an X-ray may reveal a bone fracture that requires immobilization and treatment.”**

quiz.question: ____ conjecture
quiz.explanation: 推测，仅仅是推测。That's mere conjecture without proof. 那仅仅是推测没有证据。 | con->共同，ject->投掷（拉丁jacere），ure->结果，conjecture->把想法投到一起=推测（cf. project投影，inject注射，eject驱逐，subject主题） || 文化联想：三星堆青铜面具用途至今仍引发许多推测，很适合联想到 conjecture，可以说 **historical conjecture — “Ideas about the exact ritual meaning of some Sanxingdui objects remain historical conjecture when direct evidence is lacking.”**

quiz.question: _____ stricture
quiz.explanation: 批评，严厉的批评。He issued harsh stricture on the policy. 他对政策发出严厉的批评。 | strict->收紧（拉丁stringere），ure->结果，stricture->收紧=严苛批评/狭窄（cf. strict严格，restrict限制，constrict收缩，string绳） || 文化联想：古代御史上奏弹劾官员时往往措辞严厉，最适合联想到 stricture，可以说 **a harsh stricture — “A censor’s memorial could contain a harsh stricture on an official accused of corruption or neglect.”**

quiz.question: ________ juncture
quiz.explanation: 时刻，关键时刻。We are at a critical juncture. 我们处于关键时刻。 | junct->连接（拉丁jungere），ure->结果，juncture->连接点=关键时刻（cf. junction连接点，conjunct连接，injunction禁令，adjunct附加） || 文化联想：赤壁之战前孙刘是否联合抗曹是决定局势走向的关键关头，很适合联想到 juncture，可以说 **a critical juncture — “The decision to resist Cao Cao before the Battle of Red Cliffs came at a critical juncture in the struggle for the south.”**

quiz.question: ______ expenditure
quiz.explanation: 支出，公共支出。Public expenditure increased this year. 今年公共支出增加了。 | ex->向外，pend->称量/付款（拉丁pendere），iture->行为，expenditure->向外付款的行为=支出（cf. spend花费，expense费用，pendant悬挂，ponder深思） || 文化联想：修长城、开运河这类大型工程都需要巨额公共开支，最适合联想到 expenditure，可以说 **public expenditure — “Building and maintaining a vast canal system required enormous public expenditure over many years.”**

quiz.question: _____ forfeiture
quiz.explanation: 没收，资产没收。Asset forfeiture was ordered by the court. 法院下令资产没收。 | forfeit->失去（古法语forfaire->做错），ure->结果，forfeiture->做错后的没收（cf. forfeit没收，forfeit a game输掉，crime犯罪） || 文化联想：古代“抄家”会把获罪官员的财产没收充公，很适合联想到 forfeiture，可以说 **property forfeiture — “When a disgraced official’s estate was confiscated by the state, the punishment amounted to property forfeiture.”**

quiz.question: ______ discomfiture
quiz.explanation: 尴尬，社交尴尬。His gaffe caused social discomfiture. 他的失礼造成了社交尴尬。 | dis->否定，comfort->安慰/强化（拉丁confortare），ure->结果，discomfiture->被打败/尴尬（cf. comfort安慰，discomfort不适，disconcert使困惑） || 文化联想：正式宴席上说错称呼、坐错席位造成的尴尬很适合联想到 discomfiture，可以说 **social discomfiture — “Calling an elder by the wrong title at a formal banquet can cause obvious social discomfiture.”**

quiz.question: divestiture ____
quiz.explanation: 剥夺，剥夺计划。The company announced a divestiture plan. 公司宣布了剥夺计划。 | di->去除，vest->穿着（拉丁vestis），iture->行为，divestiture->去除穿着=剥夺权利（cf. invest投资=穿上权力，divest剥夺，vest背心，vestment法衣） || 文化联想：现代企业出售非核心子公司、退出某项业务的做法最适合联想到 divestiture，可以说 **a divestiture plan — “A large Chinese company may announce a divestiture plan to sell a non-core subsidiary and focus on its main business.”**

quiz.question: _____ investiture
quiz.explanation: 授职，皇家授职。The royal investiture ceremony was grand. 皇家授职仪式很隆重。 | in->使穿上，vest->穿着，iture->行为，investiture->穿上权力=授职（cf. invest投资，divestiture剥夺，vest背心，divest剥夺权利） || 文化联想：古代皇帝授予官职、赐予冠服的正式仪式很适合联想到 investiture，可以说 **an investiture ceremony — “A newly appointed official might receive robes, seals, and formal recognition in an investiture ceremony.”**

quiz.question: horticulture _____
quiz.explanation: 园艺，园艺课。She took a horticulture class. 她上了园艺课。 | hortus->花园（拉丁），cult->耕作，ure->状态，horticulture->耕作花园=园艺（cf. garden花园，cultivate耕种，agriculture农业，culture文化） || 文化联想：苏州园林里花木修剪、盆景培育和四季栽植都属于园艺，可以说 **traditional horticulture — “The carefully pruned trees and cultivated flowers of a Suzhou garden reflect a long tradition of horticulture.”**

quiz.question: ____ denture
quiz.explanation: 假牙，全口假牙。He needed a full denture. 他需要全口假牙。 | dent->牙（拉丁dens），ure->器具，denture->牙的替代品=假牙（cf. dental牙齿的，dentist牙医，indent锯齿形，trident三叉戟） || 文化联想：中国老人常说“装假牙”，这正是 denture 最直接的生活联想，可以说 **a full denture — “An elderly patient who has lost most of his teeth may be fitted with a full denture.”**

quiz.question: indenture ________
quiz.explanation: 契约，契约合同。The servant signed an indenture contract. 仆人签署了契约合同。 | in->进入，dent->齿（拉丁dens），ure->结果，indenture->锯齿形契约（古代用锯齿割开合同双方各执一半，cf. indent缩进，dental牙齿） || 文化联想：旧中国的长工契约可以帮助理解 indenture，但两者并不是完全相同的法律制度，可以说 **a formal indenture — “A historian might compare an old labor contract in China with a formal indenture while noting that the legal institutions were not identical.”**

quiz.question: ______ cloture
quiz.explanation: 终止辩论，援引终止辩论。The Senate would invoke cloture. 参议院会援引终止辩论。 | clot->关闭（法语，拉丁claudere），ure->行为，cloture->关闭辩论=终止辩论（cf. close关闭，closure关闭，exclude排除，preclude阻止） || 文化联想：古代廷议时皇帝一句“不必再议”在功能上有点像强行结束辩论，但并不等同于现代议会 cloture，可以说 **invoke cloture — “In a modern legislature, leaders may invoke cloture to end debate, a procedure quite different from an emperor simply ordering a court discussion to stop.”**

quiz.question: ____ scripture
quiz.explanation: 经文，神圣的经文。They studied holy scripture. 他们研究神圣的经文。 | script->书写（拉丁scribere），ure->结果，scripture->书写下来的=经文（cf. script剧本，manuscript手稿，inscription铭文，describe描述） || 文化联想：佛经是中国文化里最容易帮助记忆 scripture 的例子，可以说 **Buddhist scripture — “A monk copying the Heart Sutra by hand is working with a piece of Buddhist scripture.”**

quiz.question: ______ aperture
quiz.explanation: 光圈，相机光圈。Adjust the camera aperture for brightness. 调整相机光圈以调节亮度。 | apert->开（拉丁aperire->打开），ure->结果，aperture->开口=光圈（cf. April四月=万物开放，overt公开的，overture序曲，aperitif开胃酒） || 文化联想：拍故宫夜景时调整镜头光圈控制进光量，最适合联想到 aperture，可以说 **a camera aperture — “A photographer shooting the Forbidden City at dusk may widen the camera aperture to let in more light.”**

quiz.question: _______ overture
quiz.explanation: 序曲，音乐会序曲。The concert overture was magnificent. 音乐会序曲很壮丽。 | over->向上，ture->开放（拉丁apertura），overture->开场=序曲/主动示好（cf. aperture光圈，aperitif开胃酒，April四月，overt公开） || 文化联想：中国交响音乐会开场时演奏的序曲最适合帮助记忆 overture，可以说 **a concert overture — “A Chinese orchestra may begin an evening program with a concert overture before the main works.”**

quiz.question: ________ gesture
quiz.explanation: 姿态，友好的姿态。She made a friendly gesture. 她做了友好的姿态。 | gest->行为/携带（拉丁gerere），ure->行为，gesture->身体动作=姿态（cf. digest消化，suggest建议，jest笑话，gestation孕期） || 文化联想：见面时“拱手作揖”是一种非常典型的友好礼节，可以说 **a friendly gesture — “Greeting a guest with a traditional clasped-hands salute can serve as a friendly gesture of respect.”**

quiz.question: _____ vesture
quiz.explanation: 服装，皇家服装。The king wore royal vesture. 国王穿着皇家服装。 | vest->穿着（拉丁vestis），ure->状态，vesture->穿着的整体=服装（cf. vest背心，divest剥夺，invest投资=穿上，vestment法衣） || 文化联想：皇帝身上的龙袍和冠服最适合帮助记忆 vesture，可以说 **imperial vesture — “The emperor’s dragon robe and ceremonial garments formed part of his imperial vesture.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ posture
quiz.explanation: 姿势，采取姿势。She would adopt a posture of confidence. 她会采取自信的姿势。 | pos->放置（拉丁ponere），ture->状态，posture->放置的状态=姿势（cf. position位置，compose作曲，deposit存款，impose强加） || 文化联想：中文“站如松，坐如钟”强调身体姿势端正，最适合联想到 posture，可以说 **an upright posture — “The saying ‘stand like a pine and sit like a bell’ encourages an upright posture.”**

quiz.question: ______ imposture
quiz.explanation: 冒充，巧妙的冒充。It was a clever imposture. 这是巧妙的冒充。 | im->上面，pos->放置，ture->行为，imposture->把自己放置到别人位置=冒充（cf. imposter冒充者，posture姿态，impose强加，impost关税） || 文化联想：古装故事里有人冒充钦差大臣骗取信任，最适合帮助记忆 imposture，可以说 **a clever imposture — “A fraudster who pretends to be an imperial envoy and carries a fake seal is attempting a clever imposture.”**

quiz.question: suture ____
quiz.explanation: 缝合线，缝合线。The suture line healed well. 缝合线愈合良好。 | su->缝（拉丁suere->缝），ture->结果，suture->缝合的结果=缝合线（cf. sew缝纫，seam接缝，suture缝合，couture高级女装=缝制） || 文化联想：现代外科手术后伤口会留下缝合线，最适合联想到 suture，可以说 **a suture line — “After surgery, the doctor checks the suture line to make sure the wound is healing properly.”**

quiz.question: azure ___
quiz.explanation: 蔚蓝的，蔚蓝的天空。The azure sky was cloudless. 蔚蓝的天空万里无云。 | lazaward->青金石（阿拉伯语，波斯词），azure->青金石的蓝色=蔚蓝（cf. lazuli青金石，lapis lazuli天青石，azure蔚蓝，blue蓝色） || 文化联想：青藏高原晴天时天空常呈现极深的蔚蓝色，最适合联想到 azure，可以说 **an azure sky — “On a clear day over the Tibetan Plateau, an azure sky can stretch from horizon to horizon.”**

quiz.question: _______ pyre
quiz.explanation: 火葬柴堆，葬礼火葬柴堆。They lit the funeral pyre. 他们点燃了葬礼火葬柴堆。 | pyr->火（希腊pyr），pyre->火堆（cf. pyramid金字塔=火形，pyrotechnics烟火，pyromania纵火狂，fever发烧，fire火） || 文化联想：佛教传统中高僧圆寂后有时举行“荼毗”火化，可以帮助记忆 pyre，可以说 **a funeral pyre — “In a traditional Buddhist cremation, the body may be placed on a funeral pyre before the ashes and relics are collected.”**

quiz.question: base _______
quiz.explanation: 卑鄙的，卑鄙的动机。He acted from base motives. 他出于卑鄙的动机行事。 | basis->基础（拉丁），base->底部/卑鄙的（cf. basement地下室，debase贬低，base instinct原始本能，ignoble卑鄙） || 文化联想：中文“见利忘义”最适合帮助记忆 base，因为它体现卑下自私的动机，可以说 **base motives — “A person who abandons righteousness as soon as profit appears is acting from base motives.”**

quiz.question: abase _______
quiz.explanation: 降低身份，降低自己身份。Don't abase oneself before anyone. 不要在任何人面前降低自己身份。 | a->使，base->低下，abase->使变低下=贬低（cf. debase贬低货币，humiliate羞辱，humble谦卑，degrade降级） || 文化联想：中文“奴颜婢膝”形容为了讨好权势而自我贬低，最适合联想到 abase，可以说 **abase oneself — “Someone who bows and flatters merely to win favor may abase himself before the powerful.”**

quiz.question: debase ___ ________
quiz.explanation: 贬低，贬低货币。Inflation would debase the currency. 通货膨胀会贬低货币。 | de->向下，base->价值基础，debase->降低基础价值=贬值（cf. devalue贬值，degrade降级，abase降低身份，depreciate贬值） || 文化联想：古代铜钱若不断减少铜含量、掺入廉价金属，就会降低货币实际价值，很适合联想到 debase，可以说 **debase the currency — “Reducing the metal content of coins can debase the currency even if the coins keep the same official face value.”**

quiz.question: appease _____
quiz.explanation: 平息，平息愤怒。Nothing could appease anger. 没有什么能平息愤怒。 | ap->朝向，peas->和平（拉丁pax），appease->朝向和平=平息（cf. peace和平，pacify安抚，pacifism和平主义，appeasement绥靖） || 文化联想：赔礼道歉、奉茶认错来平息长辈怒气的场景很适合联想到 appease，可以说 **appease someone’s anger — “A sincere apology and respectful gesture may help appease an elder’s anger after an offense.”**

quiz.question: grease _____
quiz.explanation: 油脂，油脂污渍。The grease stain was hard to remove. 油脂污渍很难去除。 | grease->油脂（古法语graisse，拉丁crassus->厚），grease->动物油脂（cf. grease润滑，crass粗鄙=厚重，engross使全神贯注） || 文化联想：吃重庆火锅时红油溅到白衣服上形成的油渍最适合联想到 grease，可以说 **a grease stain — “A splash of chili oil from hotpot can leave a stubborn grease stain on a white shirt.”**

quiz.question: tease _____
quiz.explanation: 分开，分开。Carefully tease apart the fibers. 小心地分开纤维。 | tease->梳理/取笑（古英语tæsan->撕扯），tease->梳理分开/取笑（cf. tease取笑，taunt嘲弄，tease out梳理清楚，tantalize诱惑） || 文化联想：缫丝或处理蚕丝时需要把纠结在一起的细纤维轻轻分开，很适合联想到 tease，可以说 **tease apart the fibers — “A silk worker may gently tease apart the fine fibers before arranging them into a smoother bundle.”**

quiz.question: ____ purchase
quiz.explanation: 购买/立足点，稳固的立足点。Get a firm purchase on the rope. 在绳子上获得稳固的立足点。 | pur->通过，chase->追求（古法语purchacier），purchase->通过追求获得=购买（cf. chase追赶，purchase购买/抓力，purvey供应） || 文化联想：拔河时双手必须牢牢抓住绳子、找到稳固着力点，最适合联想到 purchase，可以说 **get a firm purchase — “In a tug-of-war, a competitor needs to get a firm purchase on the rope before pulling with full force.”**

quiz.question: _____-_____ blasé
quiz.explanation: 冷漠的，厌世冷漠的。She had a world-weary blasé attitude. 她有厌世冷漠的态度。 | blaser->沉溺享乐（法语），blasé->因过度享乐而感到厌倦的=冷漠（cf. blast炸/吹，indifferent漠然，jaded厌倦，sophisticated世故） || 文化联想：《红楼梦》里贾府见惯奢华、对普通享受早已提不起兴趣的状态很适合联想到 blasé，可以说 **a blasé attitude — “Someone surrounded by luxury every day may eventually develop a blasé attitude toward pleasures that once seemed exciting.”**

quiz.question: erase ______
quiz.explanation: 抹去，抹去记忆。Time cannot erase memory. 时间无法抹去记忆。 | e->向外，ras->刮（拉丁radere），erase->刮掉=抹去（cf. erasure擦除，razor剃刀，raze夷平，abrade磨损，indelible不可磨灭的） || 文化联想：中文“刻骨铭心”表示有些经历怎么也无法抹去，最适合帮助记忆 erase，可以说 **erase a memory — “An experience described as ‘刻骨铭心’ is so powerful that time may never fully erase the memory.”**

quiz.question: paraphrase ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 改述，改述文本。Please paraphrase the text in your own words. 请用你自己的话改述文本。 | para->旁边，phrase->说（希腊phrazein），paraphrase->用旁边的话说=改述（cf. phrase短语，periphrasis迂回说法，circumlocution绕圈子） || 文化联想：把《论语》中的古文换成现代白话重新表达，最适合帮助记忆 paraphrase，可以说 **paraphrase the text — “A teacher may paraphrase a passage from the Analects in modern Chinese so students can understand its meaning more easily.”**

quiz.question: obese _______
quiz.explanation: 肥胖的，肥胖的病人。The obese patient needed treatment. 肥胖的病人需要治疗。 | ob->过于，es->吃（拉丁edere），obese->吃得过多=肥胖的（cf. eat吃，edible可食，comestible食物，obese肥胖，obesity肥胖症） || 文化联想：现代体检里医生会用 BMI、腰围等指标评估肥胖问题，最适合联想到 obese，可以说 **an obese patient — “A doctor may advise an obese patient to reduce health risks through diet, activity, and medical follow-up.”**

quiz.question: _______ malaise
quiz.explanation: 不适，普遍不适。He felt a general malaise. 他感到普遍不适。 | mal->坏（法语，拉丁malus），aise->轻松（法语），malaise->不轻松=身体不适（cf. malady疾病，malice恶意，malfunction故障，ease轻松） || 文化联想：梅雨季又闷又湿、让人浑身不舒服却说不上具体哪里病了，很适合联想到 malaise，可以说 **a general malaise — “Days of oppressive heat and humidity can leave a person with a general malaise even without a specific illness.”**

quiz.question: precise ___________
quiz.explanation: 精确的，精确的测量。Make a precise measurement. 进行精确的测量。 | pre->之前，cis->切（拉丁caedere），precise->提前切好=精确的（cf. concise简洁，incise切割，decision决定=切断，scissors剪刀） || 文化联想：鲁班尺讲究尺寸分毫不差，是中国传统工艺里记忆 precise 的好钩子，可以说 **a precise measurement — “A traditional carpenter using a Luban ruler must take a precise measurement before cutting a wooden joint.”**

quiz.question: imprecise ________
quiz.explanation: 不精确的，不精确的估计。The imprecise estimate was misleading. 不精确的估计具有误导性。 | im->否定，precise->精确的，imprecise->不精确的（cf. precise精确，precision精确度，approximately大约，vague模糊） || 文化联想：中文“差不多”“大概齐”常表示只是粗略估计，很适合联想到 imprecise，可以说 **an imprecise estimate — “Saying ‘差不多’ without measuring gives only an imprecise estimate rather than an exact figure.”**

quiz.question: incise _ _______
quiz.explanation: 切割，切割图案。The artist would incise a pattern. 艺术家会切割图案。 | in->进入，cis->切（拉丁caedere），incise->切入=雕刻（cf. incision切口，scissors剪刀，precise精确，concise简洁，decide决定） || 文化联想：玉雕工匠在玉佩表面刻入云纹、龙纹时最适合联想到 incise，可以说 **incise a pattern — “A jade carver may incise a cloud pattern into the surface with a fine tool.”**

quiz.question: exorcise ______
quiz.explanation: 驱魔，驱魔。The priest tried to exorcise demons. 牧师试图驱魔。 | ex->向外，orcis->发誓（希腊horkos），exorcise->用誓言驱出=驱魔（cf. exercise锻炼=向外驱动，exorcism驱魔，oath誓言） || 文化联想：钟馗捉鬼是中国民间最经典的驱邪形象之一，很适合帮助记忆 exorcise，可以说 **exorcise evil spirits — “In folk tradition, an image of Zhong Kui is believed to exorcise evil spirits and protect the household.”**

quiz.question: excise ___
quiz.explanation: 消费税，消费税。Pay the excise tax on tobacco. 缴纳烟草消费税。 | ex->向外，cis->切（拉丁caedere），excise->切掉/消费税（cf. incise刻入，precise精确，concise简洁，decision决定） || 文化联想：现代税制中对某些特定消费品征收消费税，可以帮助记忆 excise，可以说 **an excise tax — “A government may levy an excise tax on selected goods such as tobacco or other specially taxed products.”**

quiz.question: disfranchise ______
quiz.explanation: 剥夺选举权，剥夺选民选举权。The law would disfranchise voters. 该法律会剥夺选民选举权。 | dis->否定，franchise->特许/选举权（古法语franc->自由），disfranchise->剥夺自由权利=剥夺选举权（cf. franchise特许，freedom自由） || 文化联想：现代选举中如果把本来符合资格的人从选民名单中非法删除，就会剥夺其选举权，可以说 **disfranchise voters — “Removing qualified citizens from an electoral roll without lawful reason would disfranchise voters.”**

quiz.question: _____ premise
quiz.explanation: 前提，基本前提。The basic premise is flawed. 基本前提有缺陷。 | pre->之前，mis->放置（拉丁mittere），premise->提前放置的=前提（cf. mission使命，promise承诺，submit提交，emit发出） || 文化联想：《孙子兵法》“知己知彼”可以看成制定战略的基本前提，很适合联想到 premise，可以说 **a basic premise — “The idea that one should know both oneself and the opponent is a basic premise of sound strategy.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ compromise
quiz.explanation: 妥协，达成妥协。They tried to reach a compromise. 他们试图达成妥协。 | com->共同，pro->向前，mis->放置，compromise->共同向前放置=妥协（cf. promise承诺，premise前提，commit承诺，promise承诺） || 文化联想：中文“各退一步，海阔天空”最适合帮助记忆 compromise，可以说 **reach a compromise — “When both sides ‘take one step back,’ they may reach a compromise and avoid a larger conflict.”**

quiz.question: _________ counterpoise
quiz.explanation: 平衡力量，政治平衡力量。A political counterpoise was needed. 需要政治平衡力量。 | counter->对抗，poise->平衡（法语pois->重量），counterpoise->对抗的重量=平衡力（cf. poise平衡，equipoise平衡，counterweight对重） || 文化联想：阴阳相济强调两种力量彼此制约、保持平衡，可以作为 counterpoise 的文化联想，可以说 **a counterpoise of forces — “The yin-yang image suggests a counterpoise of forces in which neither side completely overwhelms the other.”**

quiz.question: turquoise ____
quiz.explanation: 绿松石，绿松石戒指。She wore a turquoise ring. 她戴着绿松石戒指。 | turquois->土耳其的（法语），turquoise->土耳其石=绿松石（绿松石经土耳其传入欧洲，cf. Turkey火鸡/土耳其，turquoise蓝绿色） || 文化联想：西藏和青海传统首饰里常见绿松石镶嵌，最适合联想到 turquoise，可以说 **a turquoise ornament — “A Tibetan-style necklace may feature a bright turquoise ornament set beside coral and silver.”**

quiz.question: _______ reprise
quiz.explanation: 重复，音乐重复。The musical reprise ended the show. 音乐重复结束了演出。 | re->再次，pris->拿取（拉丁prehendere），reprise->再次拿起=重复（cf. reprisal报复，surprise突袭=从上面拿，enterprise企业=之间拿） || 文化联想：大型晚会结尾再次出现开场主题旋律，很适合联想到 reprise，可以说 **a musical reprise — “At the end of a gala, the opening theme may return as a musical reprise that brings the program full circle.”**

quiz.question: apprise __ _____
quiz.explanation: 通知，通知事实。Please apprise of facts immediately. 请立即通知事实。 | ap->朝向，pris->评估（法语，拉丁pretium->价格），apprise->朝向评估=通知（cf. appraise评估，price价格，prize奖品，apprise告知） || 文化联想：古代“八百里加急”把军情迅速送往朝廷，很适合联想到 apprise，可以说 **apprise the court of the facts — “An urgent courier could ride day and night to apprise the court of the facts on a distant frontier.”**

quiz.question: _____________ treatise
quiz.explanation: 论文，哲学论文。He wrote a philosophical treatise. 他写了一篇哲学论文。 | traiter->处理（法语，拉丁tractare），treatise->系统处理某主题的著作（cf. treat处理，treatment治疗，tract论文，treatise专论） || 文化联想：《孙子兵法》系统讨论战争原则，是 treatise 最典型的中国文化联想之一，可以说 **a military treatise — “The Art of War is a concise military treatise on strategy, deception, terrain, and command.”**

quiz.question: _________ expertise
quiz.explanation: 专业知识，技术专业知识。She had technical expertise. 她有技术专业知识。 | expert->专家（拉丁expertus->经过检验的），expertise->专家的知识（cf. expert专家，experience经历，experiment实验，export出口） || 文化联想：景德镇老师傅对配釉、烧窑、控温积累的专业本领最适合联想到 expertise，可以说 **technical expertise — “Producing fine Jingdezhen porcelain requires technical expertise in clay, glaze, kiln temperature, and firing.”**

quiz.question: advertise ______
quiz.explanation: 做广告，在线做广告。Companies advertise online now. 公司现在在线做广告。 | ad->朝向，vert->转（拉丁vertere），advertise->转向注意=做广告（cf. advertise广告，divert转移，revert恢复，convert转变，invert颠倒） || 文化联想：直播带货和电商平台是当代中国非常熟悉的线上广告场景，最适合联想到 advertise，可以说 **advertise online — “A small tea company may advertise online through livestreams and e-commerce platforms to reach customers across China.”**

quiz.question: chastise _____
quiz.explanation: 惩罚，惩罚孩子。Parents may chastise child for misbehavior. 父母可能会因不当行为惩罚孩子。 | chaste->纯洁（拉丁castus->纯洁），chastise->让变纯洁=惩罚（cf. chaste纯洁，chastity贞洁，chasten惩戒，castigate严惩） || 文化联想：“严师出高徒”常把老师的严厉训诫与学生成长联系起来，可帮助记忆 chastise，可以说 **chastise a student — “In an old-style school, a stern teacher might verbally chastise a student for repeatedly neglecting his lessons.”**

quiz.explanation: 伪装，以...为幌子。He acted under the guise of friendship. 他以友谊为幌子行事。 | guise->外表（古法语guise，日耳曼语wisa->方式），guise->外在形式=幌子（cf. disguise伪装，wise方式，likewise同样地，otherwise否则） || 文化联想：中文“挂羊头卖狗肉”最适合帮助记忆 guise，因为它强调以一种好名义掩盖另一种实质，可以说 **under the guise of something — “A dishonest shop that ‘hangs a sheep’s head but sells dog meat’ operates under the guise of offering something better than it really does.”**

quiz.question: revise _____

quiz.question: improvise _ ____
quiz.explanation: 即兴创作，即兴创作曲调。The musician would improvise a tune. 音乐家会即兴创作曲调。 | im->否定，pro->之前，vis->看，improvise->未事先看过=即兴（cf. provide提供，provision供应，improvise即兴，impromptu即兴） || 文化联想：民间唢呐手或戏曲乐师常根据现场气氛临时加花、变奏，很适合联想到 improvise，可以说 **improvise a tune — “A skilled folk musician may improvise a tune or ornament the melody differently depending on the occasion.”**

quiz.question: _______ supervise
quiz.explanation: 监督，密切监督。The manager would closely supervise. 经理会密切监督。 | super->在上，vis->看（拉丁），supervise->从上方看=监督（cf. vision视觉，visit访问，revise修改，supervisor监督者） || 文化联想：古代大型工程都有监工盯着工匠、材料和进度，很适合帮助记忆 supervise，可以说 **closely supervise the work — “An official overseeing a major canal project would closely supervise the workers, materials, and construction schedule.”**

quiz.question: _____ pulse
quiz.explanation: 脉搏，心跳脉搏。Check the heart pulse regularly. 定期检查心跳脉搏。 | puls->推动（拉丁pellere），pulse->推动的节拍=脉搏（cf. repulse击退，impulse冲动，compel强迫，propel推进，expel驱逐） || 文化联想：中医“把脉”就是通过手指感受脉搏变化，最适合帮助记忆 pulse，可以说 **feel the pulse — “A traditional Chinese physician places fingers on the wrist to feel the pulse and assess its rhythm and quality.”**

quiz.question: repulse ______
quiz.explanation: 击退，击退攻击。The army would repulse attack. 军队会击退攻击。 | re->向回，puls->推（拉丁pellere），repulse->推回=击退（cf. pulse脉搏，impulse冲动，compel强迫，expel驱逐，propel推进） || 文化联想：长城守军击退敌军进攻的场景最适合联想到 repulse，可以说 **repulse an attack — “Defenders on a frontier fortress might use arrows, walls, and reinforcements to repulse an attack.”**

quiz.question: ______ impulse
quiz.explanation: 冲动，突然冲动。He acted on a sudden impulse. 他出于突然冲动行事。 | im->进入，puls->推（拉丁），impulse->推进内部=冲动（cf. pulse脉搏，repulse击退，compel强迫，expel驱逐，impulsive冲动的） || 文化联想：中文常说“冲动是魔鬼”，最适合帮助记忆 impulse，可以说 **a sudden impulse — “The warning ‘冲动是魔鬼’ reminds people not to act on a sudden impulse before thinking through the consequences.”**

quiz.question: convulse ____ ________
quiz.explanation: 使痉挛，笑得痉挛。The audience would convulse with laughter. 观众会笑得痉挛。 | con->共同，vuls->扯（拉丁vellere），convulse->剧烈扯动=痉挛（cf. revulsion憎恶=向后扯，avulsion撕脱，convulsion痉挛） || 文化联想：相声包袱抖得好时，观众常笑得前仰后合，很适合联想到 convulse，可以说 **convulse with laughter — “A perfectly timed xiangsheng punch line can make the audience convulse with laughter.”**

quiz.question: ______'_ license
quiz.explanation: 执照，驾驶执照。Renew your driver's license. 更新你的驾驶执照。 | licere->被允许（拉丁），license->被允许的权利=执照（cf. licit合法，illicit非法，leisure闲暇=被允许的时间，licentious放纵） || 文化联想：中国驾车上路必须持有相应驾驶证，最适合帮助记忆 license，可以说 **a driver’s license — “A driver must carry a valid driver’s license before legally operating a car on public roads.”**

quiz.question: condense _____
quiz.explanation: 凝结，凝结蒸汽。Cool air would condense steam. 冷空气会凝结蒸汽。 | con->共同，dens->密集（拉丁densus），condense->使密集=凝结（cf. dense密集，density密度，condenser冷凝器，condensed milk炼乳） || 文化联想：蒸包子时锅盖内侧的水蒸气变成小水珠，最适合帮助记忆 condense，可以说 **steam condenses — “When baozi are steamed, hot vapor touches the cooler lid and the steam condenses into droplets of water.”**

quiz.question: immense ________
quiz.explanation: 巨大的，巨大的压力。He felt immense pressure to succeed. 他感到巨大的压力要成功。 | im->否定，mens->测量（拉丁mensura），immense->无法测量的=巨大的（cf. measure测量，dimension维度，immeasurable无法衡量，enormous巨大） || 文化联想：三峡大坝这样的大型水利工程必须承受巨大的水压，很适合联想到 immense，可以说 **immense pressure — “A massive dam must withstand the immense pressure exerted by the water stored behind it.”**

quiz.question: _____ recompense
quiz.explanation: 补偿，提供补偿。They would offer recompense for damages. 他们会为损失提供补偿。 | re->再次，com->共同，pens->称量/付款（拉丁pendere），recompense->再次称量偿还=补偿（cf. compensate补偿，expense费用，pension养老金） || 文化联想：“滴水之恩，当涌泉相报”最适合帮助记忆 recompense，可以说 **recompense a kindness — “The saying ‘repay a drop of kindness with a gushing spring’ expresses the desire to recompense a kindness generously.”**

quiz.question: __________ suspense
quiz.explanation: 悬念，加剧的悬念。The music created heightened suspense. 音乐制造了加剧的悬念。 | sub->在下，pens->悬挂（拉丁pendere），suspense->悬挂在下方=悬念（cf. suspend悬挂，pendant悬挂物，pendulum钟摆，impending迫近） || 文化联想：说书人讲到最紧张处突然来一句“欲知后事如何，且听下回分解”，最适合联想到 suspense，可以说 **heighten the suspense — “By ending with ‘If you want to know what happens next, listen to the next episode,’ a storyteller can heighten the suspense.”**

quiz.question: commonsense ________
quiz.explanation: 常识的，常识的解决方案。That's a commonsense solution. 那是常识的解决方案。 | common->共同，sense->感觉（拉丁sentire），commonsense->共同的感觉=常识（cf. sense感觉，sensible明智，consent同意，resent怨恨） || 文化联想：中文“量入为出”是非常典型的常识性理财原则，最适合联想到 commonsense，可以说 **a commonsense rule — “The principle ‘spend according to what you earn’ is a commonsense rule for keeping a household budget under control.”**

quiz.question: rinse _____

quiz.question: verbose ______

quiz.question: bellicose ________

quiz.question: metamorphose ____
quiz.explanation: 变形，变形成。The caterpillar would metamorphose into a butterfly. 毛毛虫会变形成蝴蝶。 | meta->变化（希腊），morph->形状，ose->动词化，metamorphose->形状变化=变形（cf. metamorphosis变形，morphology形态学，amorphous无形的） || 文化联想：孙悟空七十二变是中国文化里最适合帮助记忆 metamorphose 的形象，可以说 **metamorphose into another form — “In Journey to the West, Sun Wukong can metamorphose into animals, objects, and other forms through his transformations.”**

quiz.question: grandiose ______
quiz.explanation: 浮夸的，浮夸的计划。His grandiose scheme failed. 他浮夸的计划失败了。 | grand->宏大（法语，拉丁grandis），iose->充满...的，grandiose->过于宏大的=浮夸的（cf. grand宏大，grandeur宏伟，grandma奶奶，grande大） || 文化联想：《阿房宫赋》把秦宫描写得极其宏大奢华，很适合联想到 grandiose，可以说 **a grandiose scheme — “The enormous palace project described in the ‘Rhapsody on Epang Palace’ evokes a grandiose scheme of imperial construction.”**

quiz.question: otiose ______
quiz.explanation: 无用的，无用的努力。That was an otiose effort. 那是无用的努力。 | otium->闲暇（拉丁），ose->充满...的，otiose->充满闲散=无用的（cf. negotiate谈判=不闲着，leisure闲暇，idle闲散，redundant多余） || 文化联想：成语“画蛇添足”最适合帮助记忆 otiose，因为多画的脚完全多余无用，可以说 **an otiose addition — “The extra legs in the story ‘Drawing a Snake and Adding Feet’ are an otiose addition that only ruins the original work.”**

quiz.question: foreclose _ ________
quiz.explanation: 取消抵押品赎回权，取消抵押贷款赎回权。The bank would foreclose a mortgage. 银行会取消抵押贷款赎回权。 | fore->提前，close->关闭，foreclose->提前关闭=取消赎回权（cf. close关闭，closure关闭，disclose披露，include包括） || 文化联想：现代房贷如果长期断供，贷款机构可能依法处置抵押房产，这很适合联想到 foreclose，可以说 **foreclose on a mortgage — “If a borrower stops making mortgage payments for a long period, a lender may seek to foreclose on the mortgaged property through the legal process.”**

quiz.question: disclose _______
quiz.explanation: 披露，披露细节。Please disclose details of the plan. 请披露计划的细节。 | dis->分开，close->关闭（拉丁claudere），disclose->打开=披露（cf. close关闭，enclose围住，foreclose取消赎回权，recluse隐士） || 文化联想：中文“开诚布公”最适合帮助记忆 disclose，可以说 **disclose the details — “To act with complete openness, officials should disclose the details rather than hide important facts from the public.”**

quiz.question: lachrymose _____
quiz.explanation: 催人泪下的，催人泪下的戏剧。The lachrymose drama was emotional. 催人泪下的戏剧很感人。 | lacrima->泪水（拉丁），ose->充满...的，lachrymose->充满泪水的=催泪的（cf. lachrymatory装泪的瓶，tear泪，weepy爱哭的） || 文化联想：中国“苦情戏”里人物动不动就泪流满面、身世凄惨，很适合联想到 lachrymose，可以说 **a lachrymose drama — “A television melodrama filled with tearful reunions and tragic misunderstandings can become a thoroughly lachrymose drama.”**

quiz.question: _______ ___ noose
quiz.explanation: 套索，收紧套索。They would tighten the noose. 他们会收紧套索。 | noose->套索（可能来自古挪威nos->绳结），noose->可滑动收紧的套圈（cf. lasso套索，lasso rope，snare陷阱，noose收紧） || 文化联想：古装刑罚场景里的绞索可以帮助记忆 noose，但它只是绳圈这种物件本身，可以说 **a hanging noose — “In a grim historical execution scene, a hanging noose may be shown as the looped rope used for strangulation.”**

quiz.question: ______ _ pose
quiz.explanation: 姿势，摆姿势。The model would strike a pose. 模特会摆姿势。 | pos->放置（拉丁ponere），pose->摆放自己的位置=姿势（cf. position位置，posture姿态，impose强加，compose作曲，expose暴露） || 文化联想：京剧演员登场时一个定格“亮相”就是非常典型的 pose，可以说 **strike a dramatic pose — “At the end of a movement, a Peking-opera performer may strike a dramatic pose and hold it for the audience.”**

quiz.question: juxtapose _____
quiz.explanation: 并置，并置想法。The essay would juxtapose ideas. 文章会并置想法。 | juxta->紧邻（拉丁），pos->放置，juxtapose->紧邻放置=并置（cf. position位置，juxtaposition并置，adjacent邻近，contiguous毗连） || 文化联想：中国对联把上下两联并排放置、彼此映照，很适合帮助记忆 juxtapose，可以说 **juxtapose two lines — “A traditional couplet juxtaposes two matching lines so that their parallel images and meanings can be compared side by side.”**

quiz.question: depose _ _____
quiz.explanation: 废黜，废黜统治者。The rebels would depose a ruler. 叛军会废黜统治者。 | de->向下，pos->放置，depose->从高处放下=废黜（cf. deposit存款=向下放，compose作曲，oppose反对，dispose处置，expose暴露） || 文化联想：武王伐纣最终推翻商纣王，可以作为 depose 的历史联想，可以说 **depose a ruler — “In traditional historical narrative, King Wu’s victory over the Shang brought down the last Shang ruler and effectively deposed him.”**

quiz.question: impose _ ___
quiz.explanation: 征收，征收税收。The government would impose a tax. 政府会征收税收。 | im->在上，pos->放置，impose->放置在上面=强加（cf. impost进口税，composer作曲家，depose废黜，dispose处置，superimpose叠加） || 文化联想：中文“苛捐杂税”最适合帮助记忆 impose，因为它让人联想到统治者把税负强加给百姓，可以说 **impose a tax — “A government that repeatedly imposes new levies may be accused of burdening ordinary people with ‘苛捐杂税.’”**

quiz.question: superimpose ______
quiz.explanation: 叠加，叠加层。Superimpose layers in the image. 在图像中叠加层。 | super->在上，im->在上，pos->放置，superimpose->在上面再放=叠加（cf. impose强加，superimposition叠加，overlay覆盖，layer层） || 文化联想：修复古画时如果把新的数字图层叠在原图上进行比对，很适合联想到 superimpose，可以说 **superimpose one image on another — “A conservator can superimpose a digital reconstruction on a scan of an old painting to compare missing details.”**

quiz.question: compose _______
quiz.explanation: 使镇定，使自己镇定。Take time to compose oneself. 花时间使自己镇定。 | com->共同，pos->放置，compose->把自己放置整齐=使镇定/创作（cf. composure镇定，decompose分解，dispose处置，impose强加） || 文化联想：“泰山崩于前而色不变”最适合帮助记忆 compose oneself，可以说 **compose oneself — “A person who remains steady even if ‘Mount Tai collapses before him’ can compose himself under extraordinary pressure.”**

quiz.question: decompose _____
quiz.explanation: 分解，分解废物。Bacteria decompose waste naturally. 细菌自然分解废物。 | de->去除，com->共同，pos->放置，decompose->去除结合=分解（cf. compose组合，composure镇定，compost堆肥，component成分） || 文化联想：农村把菜叶、秸秆等有机废物堆肥，让它们慢慢腐烂变成肥料，很适合联想到 decompose，可以说 **decompose into compost — “Vegetable scraps and crop residue can decompose into compost that is later returned to the soil.”**

quiz.question: interpose _ ________
quiz.explanation: 插入，插入问题。He would interpose a question. 他会插入问题。 | inter->之间，pos->放置，interpose->放置在之间=插入（cf. impose强加，depose废黜，compose作曲，dispose处置，repose休息） || 文化联想：古代廷议中御史突然插入一个质问、打断原来的陈述，可以帮助记忆 interpose，可以说 **interpose a question — “During a heated court debate, a censor might interpose a question that forces the speaker to address an uncomfortable point.”**

quiz.question: dispose __ _____
quiz.explanation: 处理，处理废物。Properly dispose of waste. 妥善处理废物。 | dis->分开，pos->放置，dispose->分开放置=处理（cf. disposition倾向，depose废黜，compose作曲，imposing壮观，predisposed倾向） || 文化联想：现代垃圾分类后，不同垃圾要按规定处理，最适合帮助记忆 dispose，可以说 **dispose of waste properly — “Households are expected to sort rubbish and dispose of waste properly rather than dump it wherever convenient.”**

quiz.question: transpose ____
quiz.explanation: 移调，移调音调。Transpose keys for the singer. 为歌手移调音调。 | trans->跨越，pos->放置，transpose->移到另一位置=移调（cf. transport运输，transfer转移，translate翻译，transform变形） || 文化联想：把《茉莉花》改到更适合歌手音域的调上，最适合帮助记忆 transpose，可以说 **transpose a song — “A musician may transpose ‘Jasmine Flower’ into a lower key so that it better fits a singer’s vocal range.”**

quiz.question: prose _____
quiz.explanation: 散文，散文风格。He wrote in a clear prose style. 他用清晰的散文风格写作。 | prosa->直接的话（拉丁，prorsus->直接向前），prose->直接的写法=散文（cf. prosaic平淡，verse诗，poetry诗，prosy冗长无聊） || 文化联想：五四以后白话文逐渐成为现代中文写作的重要形式，最适合帮助记忆 prose，可以说 **vernacular prose — “Writers of the New Culture Movement helped make vernacular prose a major form of modern Chinese literature.”**

quiz.question: comatose _______
quiz.explanation: 昏迷的，昏迷的病人。The comatose patient needed care. 昏迷的病人需要护理。 | coma->深度无意识（希腊koma->深睡），tose->状态，comatose->昏迷状态（cf. coma昏迷，comma逗号=koma同源，somnolent困倦） || 文化联想：古装剧里重伤人物长时间昏迷不醒的情节很适合联想到 comatose，可以说 **a comatose patient — “After a severe head injury, a character may remain a comatose patient who does not respond to family members.”**

quiz.question: relapse ____ _______
quiz.explanation: 复发，复发疾病。He would relapse into illness. 他会复发疾病。 | re->再次，laps->滑落（拉丁labi->滑），relapse->再次滑落=复发（cf. lapse失误，collapse倒塌，elapse流逝，labile不稳定） || 文化联想：中文常说“旧病复发”，就是病情好转后又再次出现，很适合联想到 relapse，可以说 **relapse into illness — “A patient who seems to recover but then becomes sick again may relapse into illness.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ glimpse
quiz.explanation: 瞥见，瞥见。I managed to catch a glimpse. 我设法瞥见了。 | glimpse->瞥见（中古英语，来自glimsen->闪光），glimpse->短暂的一瞥（cf. glimmer微光，gleam闪光，glance一瞥，gaze注视） || 文化联想：苏州园林的漏窗故意只露出一小片竹影或山石，最适合联想到 glimpse，可以说 **catch a glimpse — “Through a pierced window in a Suzhou garden, a visitor may catch a glimpse of bamboo, rock, and water beyond the wall.”**

quiz.question: rehearse _____
quiz.explanation: 排练，排练台词。Actors rehearse lines before performance. 演员在演出前排练台词。 | re->再次，herse->耙子（古法语herce->耙），rehearse->再次耙过=重复练习（cf. hearse灵车=耙形框架，rehearsal排练，repeat重复） || 文化联想：京剧演员正式登台前要反复排练唱词和念白，最适合联想到 rehearse，可以说 **rehearse one’s lines — “Before a Peking-opera performance, actors rehearse their lines, entrances, gestures, and musical cues repeatedly.”**

quiz.question: coarse ________
quiz.explanation: 粗俗的，粗俗的语言。Avoid coarse language. 避免粗俗的语言。 | coarse->粗糙（可能来自course->通常=ordinary），coarse->不精细的=粗俗（cf. course课程/过程，coarse粗糙，cf. coarse vs course区别） || 文化联想：市井争吵里满口粗俗脏话最适合帮助记忆 coarse，可以说 **coarse language — “A street quarrel filled with insults and vulgar expressions is full of coarse language.”**

quiz.question: terse _____
quiz.explanation: 简洁的，简洁的回复。He gave a terse reply. 他给出了简洁的回复。 | tersus->擦干净（拉丁），terse->干净利落的=简洁（cf. terse简洁，concise简洁，laconic简洁，pithy精辟，succinct简洁） || 文化联想：中文“言简意赅”最适合帮助记忆 terse，可以说 **a terse reply — “A response that uses only a few words but makes the meaning completely clear is a terse reply—‘言简意赅.’”**
